header_sentences: See Common People, and see Nation.

contexts.text: Nation = good, or evil; and people, truth, or falsity; and this constantly. Illustrated. AC 1260. AC 1672.
Kings, being of peoples, = truths.
As those in faith are called peoples... the Lord's royalty is predicated of peoples... which was represented in the Jewish Church... After they had received kings, they became a people. AC 1672.
The people are one () = that they all had the truth of faith together. Explained.
Women and people () = both goods and truths.
Peoples, and sons = truths.
Peoples () = truths; thus peoples = those who live in truths, that is, the Angels...
Kings of peoples... () = truths from conjoined truths and goods... Peoples = truths; in general, all spiritual things; for kings are predicated from peoples...
All the people from the extreme () = all and each one of falsities.
People, and priest () = interior truths and goods.
The spiritual are signified by the peoples whom He loves ().
People is predicated of those who are in the truth of faith.
The people of the Land, where Israel and Jerusalem are treated of, = the Spiritual Church... Illustrated.
Hence, when, in place of nation, people is mentioned, there is signified the truth of faith.
Sons of the people () = those first initiated into truths.
The people of the Land () = those of the Spiritual Church; and also the truths of this Church.
To be gathered to his peoples is to go away from those among whom he has been, and to pass to his own; thus, here, to represent no longer. (Continued. See Gather.)
Twelve princes of their peoples () = all the primary things of that Spiritual Church... Peoples = those in truths...
Two peoples shall be separated from thy viscera () = that truth is thence... It is said two peoples, because truth is interior and exterior. Explained.
People shall prevail over people () = that at first truth shall be superior to the good of truth. Explained.
People () = those of the Spiritual Church.

Peoples shall serve thee () = the truths of the Church; and peoples shall bow to thee = the truths of good [shall do so]... The peoples first named = the truths of the Church, which are called spiritual truths; and the peoples named the second time = the truths of good, which are spiritual goods... (Therefore they are different words in the Hebrew.)
Thou shalt be for a company of peoples () = an abundance (of truths). Explained.
To kill the people with the sword () = to destroy truths by falsity.
He halved the people who were with him () = the preparation and disposing of truths... in the Natural to receive the good represented by Esau.
The people who are with me () = some things of the truth of good.
We shall be one people () = conjunction as to doctrine also; (for) people = the truth of the Church, and thus doctrine. AC 4485.

He and all the people with him () = with all things which are in the Natural... People = truths; thus the people who are with him = the truths of that good; and, as all things in the Natural relate to goods and truths, these words signify with all things there.
Was gathered to his people () = was now among the things of the Divine Natural. (Continued. See Gather.)
Thus people = the truths in which are the concordant Societies, or the Societies which are in these truths.
Kingdom is predicated of Divine truth; and therefore the Lord is called... King of peoples; for by peoples are signified those who are in truth. References.
A people great and mighty () = falsities fighting against truths.

Upon thy mouth all my people shall kiss () = that everything in the Natural shall be under obedience to him... By people are signified truths; thus, in the Natural, the Knowledges of good and truth, and scientifics; for these are the truths of the Natural.
The people cried to Pharaoh for bread () = the need of good for truth... People = truth. (Explained.)
He sold to all the people of the land () = that all appropriation is from him... The people of the land = the truths of the Church; here, in the Natural.

He transferred that people to cities () = that scientific truths were referred to doctrinal things. People = truths; here, scientific truths; because they are predicated of the people of Egypt. (Explained.)
Joseph said to the people () = the influx of the Internal into scientific truths.
I will give thee for a company of peoples () = increase ad indefinitum. A company of peoples = truths from good ad indefinitum; for peoples = truths; and a company, abundance. Explained.
This one also shall be for a people () = that truth from good also shall be increased. Explained.

To him shall the obedience of the peoples be () = that from His Divine Human should proceed the truths which could be received... The peoples = those in truths, thus truths; and hence those of the Spiritual Church.

He shall judge his people as one of the tribes of Israel () = that it is one of the truths in general... People = those in truth; here, those in truth and not yet in good; for they are the people of Daniel.

I am gathered to my people () = that he must be in the goods and truths of the Natural which are from him; (because his people, here, are the sons of Israel and the tribes from them). Explained. AC 6465.
The congregation of the people () = those who are in the truths which are of intelligence.
To vivify a great people () = that hence is life for those who are in the truths of good. (Explained.)
Pharaoh said to his people () = to the subordinate scientifics. People = truths; and, in the opposite sense, falsities; here, scientifics separated from truth, because it is the people of Egypt.
The reason people = truths, is that in the Word that is called a people which is under a king...
By a people is signified truths; but there is meant those who are in truths.
The people was multiplied, and became exceedingly numerous () = that the truths in the Natural were being continually produced, and thus increased.
Pharaoh commanded all his people () = a general influx into the scientifics which are contrary to the truths of the Church.
To call the peoples into the mountain () = to cause truths to become goods, or faith charity; for peoples = the truths of faith...
I have seen the affliction of my people () = mercy towards those of the Spiritual Church after infestations by falsities.
Lo, the people of the land are now many () = the multitude of those who are of the Spiritual Church.

I will receive you to Me for a people () = that they shall be added to those in Heaven who are serving the Lord there... for those who are there are called the Lord's people; and the same also when they are in the world.

I will lead forth My army. My people, the sons of Israel () = that those in goods and truths are to be liberated... People is predicated of those who are in spiritual truth and good; thus denotes those of the Spiritual Church.

Let My people go that they may serve Me () = that they should leave those who are of the Church so that they may worship their God in freedom... The sons of Israel, who are here My people, = those of the Spiritual Church. AC 7439. AC 7443. AC 7500. AC 7540. AC 7641.
Into the house of... thy people () = (that they shall fill) all things in the Natural. Explained. AC 7357.
The people (of Pharaoh) = the several ones (who are in falsities and infest). AC 7543.
I will put redemption between My people and thy people () = the deliverance of those of the Spiritual Church from those in the Hells near. Explained.
As yet dost thou exalt thyself against My people () = that he does not yet desist from infesting those who are in truth and good. Explained.
The servants and people (of Pharaoh) = those who were subordinate. Explained.

Go forth, thou, and all the people who are in thy feet () = a supplication that they may depart from those in truth from the Divine, from the highest to the lowest... People = those who are in truth from the Divine; for the sons of Israel, who are here the people = those of the Spiritual Church; thus those in the truth of good and in the good of truth; here, those in truth from the Divine, because it is said the people who are in thy feet; for Moses = truth Divine... thus the highest; and the people in his feet, = all and each who are in truth from the Divine.
In Pharaoh's sending the people away () = when those who have infested were leaving those of the Spiritual Church.
(Pharaoh) took his people with him () = with falsities all and each. People = truths, in the opposite, falsities; here, falsities from evil, which are represented by Pharaoh and the Egyptians.
The peoples have heard () = all who are in falsities from evil everywhere. Peoples = those in truths from good; in the opposite, those in falsities from evil. Explained.
Until Thy people shall pass over () = that, without danger of infestation, all will be saved who are in the faculty of receiving the truth of good and the good of truth.

For people, in general, = those in the truth and good of faith. References. But here it means Israel, that is, those of the Spiritual Church, or, what is the same, those in the truth of good and in the good of truth.
Pass on before the people () = that he may lead and teach... those of the Spiritual Church.
Who hath snatched His people from under the hand of the Egyptians () = mercy towards those who are in the good of truth and truth of good.
All the people standing over thee from morning till evening () = that those of the Spiritual Church then have everything of will thence in every state.

Thou wilt pine away, both thou, and this people which is with thee () = that thus the truth which has been inseminated will perish... Moses = the truth from the Divine; and the people, those who receive it.
See thou out of all the people () = the choosing of inservient truths.
All this people shall come upon its place in peace () = that those of the Spiritual Church shall be in good, and shall thus be led from good.
He gave them [as] heads over the people () = influx into these truths. Explained.
Go away to the people () = conjunction... The people = those of the Spiritual Church.
Moses descended from the Mount to the people () = application and preparation through truth from the Divine to receive truths in good.
Conjure the people lest they break through to Jehovah to see () = lest those of the Spiritual Church should desire [to come] into the Heaven where there is what is celestial.
The people cannot ascend to Mount Sinai () = that (those of the Spiritual Kingdom) cannot elevate themselves to the Celestial Kingdom.
To strike the peoples with his horns () = to destroy falsities by means of truths.
If thou shalt lend silver to my people... () = the instruction of those in ignorance of truth... People = those in truths; here, in ignorance of truth, because it is said a needy people.
People () = those in truths of doctrine.
The needy of thy people shall eat () = conjunction through the good of charity with those who are in few truths, and yet long to be instructed... People = those of the Church.
I will disturb all the people () = the consternation of all falsities.
All the people answered with one voice () = reception in the understanding by those who are truly of the Church.
The peoples = those who are of the Church and in truths; thus also the truths of the Church. References.
He shall be cut off from his peoples () = separation and spiritual death... Peoples = those of the Church in the truths and goods of faith.
I will do wonders before all thy people () = that the Word is Divine in each and all things for the Church. The people of Moses = where the Church is...
The people in the midst of whom Moses is () = the Church where the Word is; thus all by whom the Word is received.
Concerning the nations or peoples outside the Church in Heaven. Chapter.
People (is the expression which is) predicated of truth, or falsity. DSS 86, Illustrated.
Therefore those of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom are called peoples.
From every... people... ()... By people are signified those who are in the truths of doctrine; and, abstractedly, the truths of doctrine. ( = those who are in spiritual good. AE 331.)
Peoples and tongues () = those in truths from doctrine; peoples, those in truths...
Peoples = those who are in truths or falsities of doctrine. Illustrated. AR 505.
People = those in truths; and, abstractedly, truths.
Peoples = those in doctrine.
They shall be His people () = that they are the Lord's...
Then the five fellow-countrymen...
In populous cities...
Concerning a certain people in the universe.
A city quite populous...
The land where they are is populous.
Peoples = those in truths, or falsities... Abstractedly from persons, peoples = truths, or falsities. AE 175:3, Illustrated. AE 331:4. AE 355:16.
A sign for the peoples () = that He is seen by those in truths.
When nation and people are mentioned people = those in spiritual good.
Those are called in the Word peoples who are in truths.
The people of the land = falsities in general.
The people which shall be created... () = all who are being reformed.
People = those in the Church who are in truths.
People is predicated of those who are in truths.
Peoples are predicated of truths; and, in the opposite sense, of falsities.
Peoples = those in truth; here, in spiritual truth.
People = those in spiritual good... thus who are of the Spiritual Church.
Peoples = those of the Spiritual Kingdom... thus those in spiritual good...
Peoples = those in the good of charity and thence in the truths of faith. AE 331:9.
Peoples = the truths of the Church.
A people distracted and peeled () = those from whom truths have been taken away, changed, or perverted...
Peoples = those of His Spiritual Church.
The sons of Israel = the Spiritual Church... therefore they are called peoples.
In the opposite sense, peoples = those in falsities. Illustrated.
In these passages, peoples = those who are against the truths of the Spiritual Church; thus who are in falsities.
His people () = those in truths from good; thus who receive.
Those are called His peoples () who are in truths from good; thus who, through them, receive Him.
Evils and falsities which are against the truths and goods of the Church, are signified by, all the peoples ().
The people of Jehovah = those in spiritual good.
People = those in falsities. AE 406:6.
To ascend against My people Israel () = to attack the truths of the Church.
Jehovah shall speak peace to His people () = to those who are in truths from good.
People = the Church as to truths; thus the truths of the Church.
It is said, The Lord hath a controversy with His people ()... because by people are meant those who are in truths and who are in falsities.
People = those in truths.

Peoples from afar () = those in goods; and, abstractedly, goods, in the natural man... Here, peoples = goods, because derived from a different word in the Original Language... nations also being named from this word.
Peoples = those in spiritual good, which is the good of charity towards the neighbour. AE 433:19.
To Him the obedience of the peoples () = truths from Him, and conjunction through them.
A firm people () = those in the falsities of evil; a people of depths of lip = falsities of doctrine confirmed even to the appearance of truth...
Peoples = all who are in falsities from ignorance.
Peoples = those in doctrine.
The people is grass () = those who were in truths, now in falsities.
People = those in truths, thus truths.
To slay the people () = to extinguish the truths of the Church.
The falsities which shall be dispersed are signified by, They shall devour all the peoples round about ().
The people of holiness = those of the Church in Divine truths; abstractedly. Divine truths.
Peoples = those in truths from (the good of charity).
Those of the Spiritual Church are called peoples... Those called peoples are those who are in truths as to doctrine and as to life.
People is said of those in the truths of faith.
A foolish people () = falsities.
The people = the Church from them.
All the peoples of the earth have... left him () = all the truths of the Church...
(Which disperseth) the people = the truths of the Church.
People = all in truths or falsities, whether of the Church or outside it...
Gathered to their peoples = to their own; that is, to those like them in the other life...
Thy people = the Church, and those in truths from good there.
People = those in falsities. AE 923:5. AE 1077.
People = those in falsities of evil.
People = those then of the Church.
People is said of those in truths and through them in good...
The noise of the peoples () = contradictions by falsities.
People = those of the Church in truths. AE 863:end.
Peoples = those in falsities; abstractedly... the falsities of doctrine.
Much people more than thou () = falsities in general.
Peoples = those in truths; therefore it is said that He shall judge the peoples in Truth ().
Peoples = those in the truths of the Church.
People = those in the truths of doctrine.
My people () = those in truths, and through truths in the good of life.
